newsitem.title: USA: Biscayne sees no 96 return to profitability.
newsitem.headline: Biscayne sees no 96 return to profitability.

text.p: Biscayne Apparel Inc said Friday that it does not expect to return to profitability in 1996, but that the company will show "significant improvement" in operating comparisons to 1995.
In a release Friday Biscayne said it was continuing to implement strategic initiatives which the company expects will "generate significant administrative and operational cost savings" in 1996.

However, Biscayne said it does not see a return to profitability this year. The company added it expects to "create a leaner more competitive company that will show significant immprovement in operating comparisons to 1995" through its "strategic operating plan."
